message:
You know that one friend who panics at the first sign of a storm? Well, I used to be that friend! I’ve learned that a little planning can turn even the wildest weather into a cozy night in. I found a handy resource that outlines what to do before, during, and after a hurricane, so you can approach storms like a seasoned pro rather than a headless chicken. It’s all about having a plan and some supplies ready—just in case. 

What’s your favorite tip for staying calm when the skies get a bit too dramatic? 🌪️
